attributes.action: Scrap the plan to double time taken to qualify for permanent settlement.
attributes.background: Scrap the government's plan to double the standard length of time migrants have to live in the UK to qualify for permanent settlement.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Make all visa holders eligible for ILR after 5 continuous years of residency
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771200

Legislate to protect ILR applicants from retrospective changes
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775267

Protect the five-year ILR route for existing Skilled Workers
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785621
